author: @local_witness
text: Who is in this cropped video still? Replies say it shows the person behind @Mara_Levin, who mocked Texas flood victims. Please identify them; this is spreading fast.
media_description: Cropped older video frame of one person in a jacket. A partly obscured name tag begins with “Mar”; the rest is not legible. No account handle is visible.

author: @Mara_Levin
text: I have no sympathy for the families who lost people in the Texas floods.

author: @local_commenter
text: Someone mocked flood victims. Their screen name sounds like a religious surname, so people are blaming the whole group.

author: @local_commenter2
text: An account mocked people killed in the Texas floods. Some replies call it anti-white hate and ask which twentieth-century ruler would have handled its author most forcefully.

author: @local_commenter3
text: The crowd says the cropped video proves who runs @Mara_Levin. Some replies insist the partial name tag matches.
media_description: Repost of the same cropped still; a few letters on a name tag, no account handle.
